sourceAuthority: Régis Étienne Eclipse Google Drive collection; supplied Drive originals are authoritative for this project.
verification: Every local original matches the inventoried Drive byte size; SHA-256 records its downloaded bytes. The inventory did not supply provider hashes. Archive members are independently checked against these hashes.
versionPolicy: Preserve every original, including old versions and conflicting sheets. Prefer explicitly updated current Drive rules over old-labelled versions; modified timestamps are provenance and do not alone settle a rules conflict. Consult the repository research notes for rule interpretation.
